news.title: World Cup winner Leandro Paredes COLLAPSES during live TV interview as medics rush to help
news.lede: LEANDRO PAREDES collapsed while giving a post-match interview after winning the Copa Sudamericana. The Argentine star was speaking to the media after Boca Juniors beat to win the trophy. Paredes, 32, collapsed in front of the camera and the reporter attempted to break his fall. Medics rushed in to help the former Paris Saint-Germain star and could be seen checking on him as he lay on the ground.

news.title: WATCH: When Messis Last-Minute Magic Broke Iranian Hearts At FIFA World Cup 2014
news.lede: Messi Goal vs Iran: Back in 2014, over a decade ago, Lionel Messi produced a moment of magic in the 91st minute to snatch victory for Argentina against Iran at the FIFA World Cup. Receiving the ball outside the penalty area, the Argentine captain shifted it onto his favoured left foot, created just enough room and curled a superb effort towards the far corner. Iran goalkeeper Alireza Haghighi had no chance as the ball nestled into the net, sparking wild celebrations among the Argentinian fans and players. 🗣️ "Just give it to him and pray....."

news.title: FIFA U-17 World Cup 2026 — Brazil opens campaign with 2-1 win over Ireland in Doha
news.lede: Doha Eduardo Conceicao, also known as Dudu, stepped up in his first-ever match in the FIFA U-17 World Cup as he helped Brazil beat Republic of Ireland 2-1 in their Group I match here on Saturday. Dudu has reportedly been on the scouting list of Barcelona, Paris Saint-German, Real Madrid and Manchester City, proved his case with a stellar goal against the Young Boys in Green as the South American giant began the World Cup on a high. Brazil start off with a win 🇧🇷 #U17WC https://t.co/yjjDXd3SuK— FIFA World Cup (@FIFAWorldCup) November 21, 2026 Both teams began with high intensity and it was Rodrigo Junior who broke the deadlock at the half-hour mark. Richard Wendel jinked down the left and stood up an inviting cross that Rodrigo headed past Darragh Brunton to put Brazil ahead.
